Package restaurantrush.entity

Class Customer

java.lang.Object
restaurantrush.entity.Customer
Direct Known Subclasses:
CriticCustomer, RegularCustomer, VIPCustomer
public abstract class Customer extends Object
A restaurant customer. Every customer follows the same visit flow: WAITING, SEATED, ORDERED, EATING, READY_TO_PAY and finally PAID or LEFT.

Each subclass sets how fast the customer loses patience, if they get a discount, how they pick their food and what happens when they are served. The game calls these methods without needing to know the customer type.

The methods that change the status are package-private, so only the restaurant and staff classes can use them.

      protected Customer(int id, int arrivalTurn, long seed)
      Creates a customer who has just arrived.

      public MenuItem chooseItem(Menu menu)
      Chooses what to order. By default it picks a random item from the menu using the customer's seeded random, so the same seed gives the same choices every time.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the chosen item

    • onServed

      protected void onServed(int turn)
      Called once when the customer's food is served. The default does nothing; subclasses can override it to react to the service.
      Parameters:
      turn - the turn the food was served
